meta.description: Adds paths between neighbouring paths that grow on the same parent where they drift apart, like the rays of a cap towards its margin. A new path starts where the gap opens, follows both neighbours and grows in thick from its start.

plant.description: The paths, fanned out around their parent

spacing.description: Neighbouring paths are at most this many path thicknesses apart, a new one starts between two where they drift further apart. 0 adds none.
